Title: Point-to-site VPN connectivity in Virtual WAN preview

Body.Content:
We're pleased to announce support for point-to-site VPN in Azure Virtual WAN. 

A point-to-site (P2S) VPN lets you create a secure connection to your virtual WAN from an individual client computer. A P2S connection is established by starting it from the client computer. This solution is useful for telecommuters who want to connect to Azure Virtual Networks from a remote location, such as from home or a conference. 

Learn more
